name: cross-plugin-coupling

free_hooks_no_longer_consumed_by_pro.removed_in: Pro 1.2.0 (Messaging engine deleted from Pro; messaging is now Free-only)

free_filters_pro_extends_but_free_does_n.free_status: Free does NOT apply_filters('mvs_settings_sections') anywhere — Pro-side ProSettings.php registers sections that Pro itself renders. Settings page in Free uses a different SettingsRegistrar group-based contract. Marking as Pro-only ecosystem hook (Pro listens, Pro fires).
Free does not fire mvs_notification_types — Free's NotificationService uses an internal const TYPE_* registry. Pro hook is for Pro→Pro extension only.
Free does not fire mvs_notification_message — Free composes messages via a switch in NotificationService::format_message(). Pro hook works only when Pro composes its own messages.

Free does not apply_filters('mvs_locate_template') — TemplateLoader uses load_template() directly. Pro can override via template_include or single_template chain instead. Listed as documentation gap, not a runtime bug.
Free does not apply_filters('mvs_upload_args') — Pro's QuotaService can intercept REST args via rest_pre_dispatch instead. Pre-existing manifest-drift; predates 1.2.0.
Free does not apply_filters('mvs_feed_media_ids') — Free's feed query is direct $wpdb in ActivityService. Pre-existing.
Free does not do_action('mvs_dashboard_tabs') — dashboard tab markup is hard-coded in the dashboard-view block. Pro listener never fires.

Free does not do_action('mvs_settings_render_license') — only do_action('mvs_settings_render_' . $tab) dynamic. Pro passes its own tab name; works only for tab routing, not as a render-after hook on Free's existing tabs.

notes: 1.2.0 refresh: Pro deleted its Messaging engine entirely (Pro/includes/Messaging/ no longer exists). The mvs_message_sent listener at Pro/includes/Messaging/NotificationListener.php:33 is gone — that contract is now Free-only. Free still fires mvs_message_sent (MessagingService.php:832 + 350) but only Free-side listeners (Social/NotificationService.php:56 + Messaging/NotificationListener.php:33) catch it. Discovered 14 Pro-side filters/actions that listen for hooks Free does not fire (extensibility-gap candidates) — most are Pro-internal ecosystem hooks (compete/challenges/tournaments) so not actionable for Free. Three are documentation gaps where Free could fire a hook to enable Pro extensibility (mvs_dashboard_tabs/panels, mvs_after_content) — defer to 1.2.1 or 1.3.
